bio.text: Mike Mazzei is the Republican candidate for Governor of Oklahoma in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia reports he defeated Gentner Drummond in the August 25, 2026 Republican primary runoff.
He represented Oklahoma State Senate District 25 from 2004 to 2016 and worked as a financial planner, founding The Financial Coach, Inc.
He holds a B.A. in government and politics from George Mason University.
